description: Source code for managing GitLab prompts, including classes for prompt templates, managers, caching, and integration with prompt management base. Handles loading, parsing, rendering, and caching of prompt files from GitLab repositories with support for configurable prompt folders.

classes.name: GitLabPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from GitLab, including content, metadata, and model info.

classes.name: GitLabTemplateManager
classes.description: Manages loading, parsing, and rendering of prompt files from GitLab repositories, supporting prompt folder configuration.

classes.name: GitLabPromptManagement
classes.description: Extends prompt management to integrate with GitLab, providing prompt retrieval, rendering, and pre/post call hooks.

classes.name: GitLabPromptCache
classes.description: Caches all prompt files from a GitLab repo into memory for quick access and management.

methods.name: encode_prompt_id
methods.description: Encodes a prompt ID by prefixing with 'gitlab::' and replacing '/' with '::'.

methods.name: decode_prompt_id
methods.description: Decodes an encoded prompt ID back to its original form by removing prefix and replacing '::' with '/'.

methods.name: GitLabPromptTemplate.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a prompt template with ID, content, metadata, and optional model.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the manager with GitLab config, optional prompt ID, ref, and client; sets up environment and prompt path.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager._id_to_repo_path
methods.description: Converts a prompt ID to a repository file path respecting prompts folder and extension.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager._repo_path_to_id
methods.description: Converts a repo file path to a prompt ID relative to prompts folder.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager._load_prompt_from_gitlab
methods.description: Loads a specific prompt file from GitLab into the manager.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager.load_all_prompts
methods.description: Loads all prompt files from GitLab under prompts folder.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager._parse_prompt_file
methods.description: Parses prompt content and frontmatter into a GitLabPromptTemplate object.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager.render_template
methods.description: Renders a prompt template with variables using Jinja2.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager.get_template
methods.description: Retrieves a loaded prompt template by ID.

methods.name: GitLabTemplateManager.list_templates
methods.description: Lists available prompt IDs under prompts folder, compatible with different list_files signatures.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.get_prompt_template
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a prompt template, returning prompt string and metadata.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.pre_call_hook
methods.description: Prepares messages and parameters before calling the language model, based on prompt template.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement._parse_prompt_to_messages
methods.description: Parses prompt string into structured chat messages.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.post_call_hook
methods.description: Post-processing after model call (default: returns response unchanged).

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.get_available_prompts
methods.description: Returns list of prompt IDs, prioritizing in-memory loaded prompts.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.reload_prompts
methods.description: Reloads all prompts from GitLab.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.should_run_prompt_management
methods.description: Determines if prompt management should run for given prompt ID.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement._compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Compiles prompt into a PromptManagementClient object, loading prompt if necessary.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.async_compile_prompt_helper
methods.description: Async version delegating to sync compile prompt helper.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Delegates to base class to get chat prompt.

methods.name: GitLabPromptManagement.async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Async delegate for getting chat prompt.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.__init__
methods.description: Initializes cache with GitLab config and optional ref.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.load_all
methods.description: Loads all prompt files from GitLab into cache.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.reload
methods.description: Clears cache and reloads prompts from GitLab.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.list_files
methods.description: Lists cached file paths.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.list_ids
methods.description: Lists cached prompt IDs.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.get_by_file
methods.description: Retrieves cached prompt JSON by file path.

methods.name: GitLabPromptCache.get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves cached prompt JSON by prompt ID.

methods.name: _template_to_json
methods.description: Converts a GitLabPromptTemplate into a JSON-serializable dict.
